name: Catfish
siboNotes: Plain catfish is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. Choose simple cooking methods to avoid high-FODMAP seasonings or breading.
preparationTips: Season with low-FODMAP herbs like basil, oregano, or chives
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Avoid onion powder - use green onion tops instead
Pan-fry, bake, or grill without high-FODMAP marinades
